description: Tier 1 acceptance fixture set — current-state baselines recaptured at the Phase-16-2 SEAL (post-16-2a/b/c).

fixtures.name: (S)-alanine
fixtures.purpose: Atom-level CIP consumer (R/S at α-carbon); Phase 15-2a wires consumer.

baseline.comp: The structure is a three-carbon chain. The first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The first carbon bears a carboxylic acid group (–COOH). The second carbon bears an amine group (–NH₂). Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens. Contains one defined stereocenter.
baseline.std: A 6-atom, three-carbon chain with a carboxylic acid group (–COOH), and an amine group (–NH₂).
baseline.short: A three-carbon chain with a carboxylic acid and an amine.

fixtures.name: cis-2-butene
fixtures.purpose: Bond-level stereo consumer (cis/Z); Phase 15-2a wires consumer.

baseline.comp: The structure is a four-carbon chain. The first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The second carbon bears a (Z)-configured carbon-carbon double bond (C=C). Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens.
baseline.std: A 4-atom, four-carbon chain with a carbon-carbon double bond (C=C).
baseline.short: A four-carbon chain with a double bond.

fixtures.name: trans-2-butene
fixtures.purpose: Bond-level stereo consumer (trans/E); disambiguates from #2; Phase 15-2a wires consumer.

baseline.comp: The structure is a four-carbon chain. The first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The second carbon bears an (E)-configured carbon-carbon double bond (C=C). Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens.
baseline.std: A 4-atom, four-carbon chain with a carbon-carbon double bond (C=C).
baseline.short: A four-carbon chain with a double bond.

fixtures.name: (R)-2-butanol
fixtures.purpose: Atom-level CIP consumer (R); already in migration baseline; Phase 15-2a wires consumer.

baseline.comp: The structure is a four-carbon chain. The first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The second carbon bears a hydroxyl group (–OH). Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens. Contains one defined stereocenter.
baseline.std: A 5-atom, four-carbon chain with a hydroxyl group (–OH).
baseline.short: A four-carbon chain with a hydroxyl group.

fixtures.name: butan-1-ol
fixtures.purpose: Chain locants — primary alcohol on terminal carbon; Phase 15-2b wires.

baseline.comp: The structure is a four-carbon chain. The first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The first carbon bears a hydroxyl group (–OH). Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens.
baseline.std: A 5-atom, four-carbon chain with a hydroxyl group (–OH) at C1.
baseline.short: A four-carbon chain with a hydroxyl group at C1.

fixtures.name: butan-2-ol
fixtures.purpose: Chain locants — secondary alcohol on internal carbon; Phase 15-2b wires.

baseline.comp: The structure is a four-carbon chain. The first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The second carbon bears a hydroxyl group (–OH). Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens.
baseline.std: A 5-atom, four-carbon chain with a hydroxyl group (–OH) at C2.
baseline.short: A four-carbon chain with a hydroxyl group at C2.

fixtures.name: tert-butanol
fixtures.purpose: Chain locants + branching — tertiary alcohol on quaternary carbon; Phase 15-2b wires.

baseline.comp: The structure is a three-carbon chain. The first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The second carbon bears a hydroxyl group (–OH). Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens.
baseline.std: A 5-atom, branched carbon chain with three carbons in the longest path with a hydroxyl group (–OH) at C2.
baseline.short: A three-carbon chain with a hydroxyl group at C2.

baseline.comp: The structure is a three-carbon chain. The first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The first carbon is triple-bonded to a nitrogen atom (forming a nitrile group, –CN). Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens.
baseline.std: A 4-atom, three-carbon chain with a nitrile group (–CN).
baseline.short: A three-carbon chain with a nitrile.

baseline.comp: The structure is a three-carbon chain. The first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The first carbon bears a thiol group (–SH). Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens.
baseline.std: A 4-atom, three-carbon chain with a thiol group (–SH).
baseline.short: A three-carbon chain with a thiol.

baseline.comp: The structure is a sulphoxide. The central sulphur atom is double-bonded to an oxygen and single-bonded to two methyl carbons (forming a sulphoxide group, S=O). Each methyl carbon carries three implicit hydrogens.
baseline.std: A 4-atom molecule. A sulphoxide group (S=O) with two methyl substituents.
baseline.short: A sulphoxide group flanked by two methyl groups.

fixtures.name: diethyl ether
fixtures.purpose: Acyclic ether group classification; Phase 15-2c adds.

baseline.comp: The structure is an ether. Two ethyl groups are bridged by an oxygen atom. The first ethyl: the first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The second carbon is bonded to the bridging oxygen. The oxygen is bonded to the start of a second ethyl group. The third carbon is bonded to the fourth carbon by a single bond. Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens.
baseline.std: A 5-atom molecule. Two ethyl groups bridged by an oxygen (an ether linkage).
baseline.short: Two ethyl groups bridged by an oxygen.

baseline.comp: A single carbon bearing a primary amine group (–NH₂). The nitrogen bears two implicit hydrogens, characteristic of a primary amine.
baseline.std: A methyl group bonded to a primary amine group (–NH₂).
baseline.short: A one-carbon chain with a primary amine.

baseline.comp: The structure is a secondary amine. The nitrogen atom bears one implicit hydrogen and is bonded to two methyl carbons, characteristic of a secondary amine.
baseline.std: Two methyl groups bonded to a secondary amine (–NH–).
baseline.short: A secondary amine with two methyl substituents.

baseline.comp: The structure is a tertiary amine, N(CH₃)₃. The nitrogen atom bears no hydrogens and is bonded to three methyl carbons, characteristic of a tertiary amine.
baseline.std: Three methyl groups bonded to a tertiary amine nitrogen, N(CH₃)₃.
baseline.short: A tertiary amine with three methyl substituents.

fixtures.name: acetone
fixtures.purpose: Ketone sanity canary — should already work; catches 15-2c classifier-ordering regressions.

baseline.comp: The structure is a three-carbon chain. The first carbon is bonded to the second carbon by a single bond. The second carbon bears a ketone group (C=O). Each carbon carries implicit hydrogens.
baseline.std: A 4-atom, three-carbon chain with a ketone group (C=O).
baseline.short: A three-carbon chain with a ketone.
